active NHL_OT_MODEL_NO_037 NHL_OT_MODEL_NO v1 · ot_shootout · origin self_generated
HypothesisThe Poisson tie mass, rescaled by the observed rate of games that went past regulation on an earlier chronological window, prices 'game is decided in regulation' more accurately than the exchange does; buying the NO side when the offer is at least 0.030 below that probability earns the difference.
Datakalshi.trade_api KXNHLOVERTIME contracts (offers, candlesticks, own settlement result) + api-web.nhle.com lastPeriodType for the observed overtime rate. BACKTEST NOTE: The NO side of KXNHLOVERTIME has no historical offer in Kalshi's candlestick feed (YES bid/ask only), so this rule is FORWARD TEST ONLY, entered at the live no_ask_dollars.
Entry ruleAt decision time compute P(tied after regulation) from prior games only, rescale it by the fitted OT calibration, and buy the NO side of the KXNHLOVERTIME contract when the offer is at or below that probability minus 0.030. If the calibration's sample is below its minimum the rule does not trade.
Price ruleRequire an executable NO-side offer <= model P - 0.030; never bet into a stale or missing quote.
SettlementThe exchange's own settlement result for BACKTEST rows. For FORWARD TEST rows the official NHL lastPeriodType (OT or SO = the game went past regulation, REG = it did not), cross-checked against Kalshi's result when the contract settles; a disagreement is recorded with both values and the row is left OPEN.
Marketsovertime

active NHL_PUCK_LINE_DOG_PLUS_034 NHL_PUCK_LINE_DOG_PLUS v1 · puck_line · origin self_generated
HypothesisThe independent-Poisson margin distribution prices 'the team the expected-goals model rates stronger fails to cover the 1.5-goal line' more accurately than the exchange does, so buying the NO side when the offer is at least 0.040 below the model probability earns the difference. A one-goal win -- including every overtime and shootout win -- loses a -1.5 contract, which is a different claim from the moneyline and is priced separately here.
Datakalshi.trade_api KXNHLSPREAD contracts (floor_strike, strike_type, yes/no offers, candlesticks) + api-web.nhle.com results for the expected-goals margin distribution. BACKTEST NOTE: Kalshi's candlestick feed publishes the YES bid/ask only, so no historical NO-side offer exists to buy a +1.5 puck line at, and no_ask = 1 - yes_bid does not hold on the quotes in this ledger. FORWARD TEST ONLY, entered at the live no_ask_dollars.
Entry ruleAt decision time compute expected goals from prior games only, then P(margin > k) for the offered rung k nearest 1.5 inside [1.5, 2.5]; buy the NO side of the team the expected-goals model rates stronger's contract when its offer is at or below that probability minus 0.040. A game whose offered rungs are all outside that range is skipped, and a contract with no readable floor_strike is never traded.
Price ruleRequire an executable NO-side offer <= model P(cover) - 0.040; never bet into a stale or missing quote.
SettlementOfficial NHL final score. A YES contract on team T at strike k pays when T's final goal differential (regulation, overtime and the shootout goal the official score already contains) is strictly greater than k; a NO contract pays otherwise. Kalshi's own settlement result is cross-checked against it and a disagreement is recorded with both values and left unsettled rather than resolved silently.
Marketspuck_line

active NHL_TOTALS_OVER_030 NHL_TOTALS_OVER v1 · totals · origin self_generated
HypothesisThe independent-Poisson expected-goals model prices a over total more accurately than the exchange does, so buying the over side when the offer is at least 0.040 below the model probability earns the difference. The exchange lists one contract per strike; this rule trades the offered strike nearest 6.5.
Datakalshi.trade_api KXNHLTOTAL contracts (floor_strike, yes/no offers, candlesticks) + api-web.nhle.com results for expected goals.
Entry ruleAt decision time compute expected goals from prior games only; buy the over side of the quoted strike when the offer is at or below model P(over) - 0.040. The offered strike nearest 6.5 is traded; strikes outside [4.5, 8.5] are never traded, and a game whose offered strikes are all outside that range is skipped.
Price ruleRequire an executable offer <= model P(over) - 0.040; never bet into a stale or missing quote.
SettlementOfficial NHL final score. Kalshi settles an Over k.5 contract on regulation + overtime goals, with a shootout counted as one goal for the winner -- which is what the official final score already includes, so total = home_score + away_score.

active NHL_TOTALS_UNDER_031 NHL_TOTALS_UNDER v1 · totals · origin self_generated
HypothesisThe independent-Poisson expected-goals model prices a under total more accurately than the exchange does, so buying the under side when the offer is at least 0.040 below the model probability earns the difference. The exchange lists one contract per strike; this rule trades the offered strike nearest 6.5.
Datakalshi.trade_api KXNHLTOTAL contracts (floor_strike, yes/no offers, candlesticks) + api-web.nhle.com results for expected goals. BACKTEST NOTE: Kalshi's candlestick feed publishes the YES bid/ask only, so no historical NO-side offer exists to buy an Under at, and no_ask = 1 - yes_bid does not hold on the quotes in this ledger (2 of 12 contracts on 2026-09-20). FORWARD TEST ONLY, entered at the live no_ask_dollars.
Entry ruleAt decision time compute expected goals from prior games only; buy the under side of the quoted strike when the offer is at or below model P(under) - 0.040. The offered strike nearest 6.5 is traded; strikes outside [4.5, 8.5] are never traded, and a game whose offered strikes are all outside that range is skipped.
Price ruleRequire an executable offer <= model P(under) - 0.040; never bet into a stale or missing quote.
SettlementOfficial NHL final score. Kalshi settles an Over k.5 contract on regulation + overtime goals, with a shootout counted as one goal for the winner -- which is what the official final score already includes, so total = home_score + away_score.
Marketstotal
